PLAN "12-Week Strength Return-to-Ski (Low-Impact, Knee-Friendly)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength and knee resilience for skiing without deep knee flexion or impact"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation and Tissue Capacity" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body Strength (Knee-Friendly)":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press_high_foot 4x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          rdl 4x8 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat_short_range_left 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat_short_range_right 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_leg_curl 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          tibialis_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_hip_flexor_stretch 4m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper Body Push/Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          chest_supported_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_db_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown_neutral 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank_left 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank_right 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          t_spine_opener 3m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower Body Strength + Balance":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles 4x6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press_high_foot 3x10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          step_up_low_box_right 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          step_up_low_box_left 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 4x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          cable_anti_rotation_hold 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body Strength (Knee-Friendly)":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press_high_foot 4x8 rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          rdl 4x8 rpe 6.5 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat_short_range_left 3x8 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat_short_range_right 3x8 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_leg_curl 3x10 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          tibialis_raise 3x12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          cable_pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_hip_flexor_stretch 4m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper Body Push/Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 6.5 rest 150 seconds
          chest_supported_row 4x8 rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds

          side_plank_left 3x35 rpe 6.5 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank_right 3x35 rpe 6.5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          t_spine_opener 3m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower Body Strength + Balance":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift_high_handles 4x6 rpe 6.5 rest 150 seconds

          seated_calf_raise 4x10 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
          cable_anti_rotation_hold 3x35 rpe 6.5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower Body Strength (Knee-Friendly)":
